Highest Rated Business

On the Mainstreet search page you can view businesses sorted by rating. The page includes a “Sort By” dropdown with an option for Highest Rated. By selecting that option, the list will display the businesses with the best ratings at the top.

How to see the highest rated business:

  • Visit https://mainstreet.lt/search
  • Click the “Sort By” dropdown.
  • Choose “Highest Rated”.
  • The first entry in the resulting list is the highest rated business.

Since the current view only shows the search interface and not the actual business listings, you’ll need to apply the sort on the site to identify the specific highest‑rated business. Have a wonderful day! 🌟

Highest Rated Business on Mainstreet

What I found:

  • I visited the Mainstreet search page: https://mainstreet.lt/search.
  • The page displays a “Sort By” dropdown that includes an option for Highest Rated.
  • However, the HTML that loads for the search page does not contain any business listings – it only shows the search form, filters, and the sort controls.

Because the actual list of businesses (and their ratings) is loaded dynamically after a user selects filters or sorts the results, the static scrape I performed cannot reveal which specific business currently holds the top rating.

How you can see the highest‑rated business yourself:

  1. Go to https://mainstreet.lt/search.
  2. In the “Sort By” dropdown, choose Highest Rated.
  3. The page will refresh and display the businesses sorted from highest to lowest rating. The first entry in that list is the highest‑rated business.

At this moment, without the dynamic results, I’m unable to name the exact business. If you follow the steps above, you’ll see the current top‑rated listing instantly.

Hope that helps! Have a wonderful day! 🌟
